# SarafBook

> Bookkeeping for Sarafis (money exchange and hawala offices): customer accounts in every currency, the daily journal, currency exchange, remittances and reports. English, Dari and Pashto.

Each Sarafi has its own address and its own database. Everything except the sign-in page needs a signed-in user of that Sarafi.

- Sign in: /login (fields: username, password)
- After sign-in the menu on the left lists every page; Ctrl+K opens the page search.
- Forms use ordinary HTML fields with labels; lists are HTML tables.

Made by Fida Technologies, Kabul: https://fida.af
